svg.title: Exposure check for LMCache CVE-2026-105192
svg.desc: Four checks in order. One: is LMCache 0.3.9 or later running in multiprocess mode, started as lmcache server or python -m lmcache.v1.multiprocess.server. Two: is --host set to a routable address; the LMCache Kubernetes operator always passes --host 0.0.0.0, and the example DaemonSet does too. Three: who can reach the port; with hostNetwork true, anything that can reach the node IP; on the pod network, any pod unless a NetworkPolicy blocks it. Four: restrict the port to the vLLM clients that need it now, and upgrade once a release contains commit 160b6de. If the answer to check one or two is no, the network attack path in the advisory does not apply.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: LMCache 0.3.9 or later in multiprocess mode
Default is localhost. The Kubernetes operator always passes --host 0.0.0.0
Who can open a TCP connection to the port
hostNetwork: anything that reaches the node IP. Pod network: any pod, unless a NetworkPolicy blocks it
Restrict the port now, upgrade later
Allow only the vLLM pods that use it. Upgrade once a release contains commit 160b6de
The network path in the advisory does not apply. Re-check after every deploy change

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: As of October 12, 2026, no PyPI release contains the fix. One message to the port runs code as the LMCache user.
